parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json;if(!b.organization_id||!b.contact_id||!b.stage)throw new Error('organization_id, contact_id and stage required');return [{json:{organization_id:b.organization_id,contact_id:b.contact_id,stage:String(b.stage)}}];

parameters.query: UPDATE contacts SET metadata=jsonb_set(metadata,'{stage}',to_jsonb($3::text),true),updated_at=now() WHERE organization_id=$1::uuid AND id=$2::uuid RETURNING *;
